questions: Should the function handle missing values in the feature or target columns after merging, and if so, how (e.g., drop rows with NaN, raise an error, impute)?
If the 'id' column has duplicate values in either dataframe, how should the merge behave (e.g., produce Cartesian product, raise error, keep first)?
Should the function validate that the features list contains only columns present in the merged dataframe, and if missing, what action (e.g., raise KeyError, skip)?
Is the order of coefficients in the output list guaranteed to match the order of the input features list?
Should the residuals plot include any additional elements beyond the scatter plot and horizontal line at y=0 (e.g., a regression line for residuals, grid lines)?
If the merged dataframe has zero rows (e.g., no matching IDs), what should the function do (e.g., raise an error, return empty coefficients, handle gracefully)?
Should the function ensure that the target column is numeric and of a suitable type for regression, and if not, how to respond?
